answer: Agents stake compute-heavy proof-of-work unique to each hardware enclave, creating a river of verifiable cost; forging a thousand identities requires a thousand distinct chips, making the attacker’s expense scale quadratically as they cannot pool hashpower across virtual clones. This haven of physical scarcity secures the bridge between reputation and resources, but it fails if a manufacturer backdoors enclaves or if cloud providers collude to wholesalefake attestation reports, centralizing the very trust the mechanism distributes.
